subject: Post-demo: canary trial KPIs, runbook & kickoff request - Suncrest Technologies
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alexis Turner <alexis.turner@suncrest.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@suncrest.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-09T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: canary trial KPIs, runbook & kickoff request

Hi Alexis and Samir —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Appreciate the clear description of the Suncrest ingestion and retrieval use cases — the demo helped surface two things we think will give you high confidence quickly: (1) a small canary trial that validates end-to-end latency and entity extraction fidelity against your sample corpus, and (2) an acceptance checklist linked to your business KPIs so we can make a go/no-go decision after 3–4 weeks.

Proposed canary trial (summary):
- Duration: 3 weeks (plus 1 week for baseline instrumentation)
- Scope: 50k queries/day simulated (mix of 60% short queries, 40% long/context queries) against Production-like dataset you provided
- Success criteria (high level): average p95 generation latency < 450ms, intent extraction F1 >= 0.88 on flagged prompt set, token cost per query within 15% of our baseline estimate
- Owners: Suncrest Data Lead to own dataset/validation; Redwood SE to own model/serving config and dashboards

Next steps I propose this week:
1) You confirm the success criteria above or send edits by EOD Wednesday (Oct 11).
2) We share an editable POC checklist and runbook (attached) — please add your security contact for SOC2 evidence requests.
3) Schedule a 30-minute kickoff to align on data access, VPN/SFTP instructions, and monitoring hooks — my team is available next Tue/Wed morning PT.

Attachments: suncrest-poc-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-sla-summary.pdf (brief)

If this aligns, I’ll put a lightweight mutual action plan into HubSpot with owners and dates. Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock capacity.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

---

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the concise plan. Quick answers from our side: 

- The high-level success criteria look right. A few tweaks: intent extraction F1 target to 0.90 for core payment/fulfillment intents, and we want latency p95 < 400ms for short queries specifically.
- Security: Priya is our security lead and will need SOC2 artifacts + network egress details. Priya (cc’d) — can you share the preferred way for evidence collection?
- Timeline: we prefer kickoff on Wed Oct 11 at 10:00 AM PT if that works for you (we can do 30m).

We’ll need the runbook to include exact SFTP endpoints and a point-by-point list of logs/metrics you’ll expose for the trial. Also note procurement: if the canary looks good we’ll move to a small paid reserved capacity trial; Samir will coordinate PO/finance side.

Thanks — Alexis

Date: 2028-10-10T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: canary trial KPIs, runbook & kickoff request — draft POC runbook and owner map

Jordan / team — I put together a draft runbook and owner map that aligns to Alexis’s edits. Key details below; I attached the full runbook (redwood-poc-runbook-v1.docx) and a condensed checklist.

Operational plan (concise):
- Week 0 (instrumentation, 3–5 days): verify dataset transfer, baseline latency, and enable KV cache metrics. Owner: Suncrest (data transfer), Redwood SE (instrumentation).
- Week 1–3 (canary): ramp to target traffic. Daily sync brief (10m) M/W/F. Owner: Redwood SE for serving config; Suncrest QA for validation tests.
- Week 4 (evaluation): run acceptance suite and compile report; final decision by Suncrest product + engineering leads.

Measurement & acceptance:
- Latency: measure p95 for short query set and overall p95. Pass if short-query p95 < 400ms and overall p95 < 450ms.
- Quality: run the curated prompt set (150 items) with labeled ground truth; pass if core-intent F1 >= 0.90 and overall F1 >= 0.88.
- Cost: token cost must not exceed baseline +15% over trial.

Owner map (who does what):
- Suncrest: Alexis Turner (Product) — sign-off on success definitions; Samir Shah (CTO) — procurement & PO; Priya Rao (Security) — SOC2 evidence collection and network signoff; Suncrest Data Lead — dataset prep and validation.
- Redwood: Jordan Blake (AE) — overall program manager; Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer) — runbook lead & day-to-day SE; Karthik Iyer (Platform Specialist) — network/infra liaison for private endpoints and VPN config.

Security notes: we will provide SOC2 summary and a short checklist of logs we will expose (API request/response headers, anonymized token usage, and audit log entries). Priya, I’ll send the SOC2 summary and a one-pager on log retention by end of day.

Attachments: redwood-poc-runbook-v1.docx (runbook), suncrest-poc-checklist.xlsx (updated)

I’ll draft the mutual action plan in HubSpot after kickoff and tag clear due dates. Jordan — I can host the kickoff and run the technical onboarding portion if you’d like.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-1299
